title: Project configuration
description: Per-project configuration file (galivelop-images.json) read by the image generator.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

minVersion.description: Minimum generator version (semver) this project requires.

name.description: Project name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

delivery.description: Where finished images are delivered inside the project repository.

dir.description: Delivery directory, relative to the project root.

template.description: File name template for delivered images; must end in .png.

manifest.description: Manifest file path, relative to the project root.

profiles.description: Image profiles by name (size, sampling settings, model, style).

relativePath.description: Relative path that cannot be absolute, start with ~, contain .. segments or backslashes.

style.description: Fixed text appended to every prompt of this profile.
